from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
script = Path('scripts/sync.sh').resolve()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    root = Path(temp)
    (root / 'notes').mkdir()
    for name in ['first.txt', 'file with spaces.txt']:
        (root / 'notes' / name).write_text(name)
    for verbose in [False, True]:
        dest = root / ('verbose' if verbose else 'quiet')
        dest.mkdir()
        args = ['sh', str(script)] + (['--verbose'] if verbose else []) + [str(dest)]
        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        expected = 'notes/file with spaces.txt\\nnotes/first.txt\\n' if verbose else ''
        assert result.stdout == expected, result.stdout
        for source in (root / 'notes').iterdir():
            assert (dest / source.name).read_text() == source.read_text()
print('Syntax and quiet/verbose copy checks passed.')
